  {"step":2,"file":"bin/fribidi-fuzzer.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":28,"var":"str","code":"FriBidiChar *str = (FriBidiChar *) data;","note":"The input buffer is passed directly to FriBidi as the source text."},
  {"step":3,"file":"bin/fribidi-fuzzer.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":34,"var":"types","code":"fribidi_get_bidi_types (str, str_len, types);","note":"FriBidi computes bidi classes from the attacker-controlled text, which determines later run segmentation."},
  {"step":4,"file":"lib/fribidi-bidi.c","function":"fribidi_get_par_embedding_levels_ex","line":531,"var":"main_run_list","code":"main_run_list = run_list_encode_bidi_types (bidi_types, bracket_types, len);","note":"The bidi classes are encoded into a linked run list with prev/next and isolate links."},
  {"step":5,"file":"lib/fribidi-bidi.c","function":"fribidi_get_par_embedding_levels_ex","line":840,"var":"main_run_list","code":"compact_list (main_run_list);","note":"The algorithm compacts adjacent runs before weak-type resolution, so attacker-chosen adjacency can trigger node merges."},
  {"step":6,"file":"lib/fribidi-bidi.c","function":"compact_list","line":100,"var":"list","code":"if (RL_TYPE (list->prev) == RL_TYPE (list) && RL_LEVEL (list->prev) == RL_LEVEL (list) ... ) list = merge_with_prev (list);","note":"When two neighboring runs match in type and level, the current node is merged into the previous one."},
  {"step":7,"file":"lib/fribidi-bidi.c","function":"merge_with_prev","line":73,"var":"second->next->prev_isolate","code":"else if (second->next->prev_isolate == second) second->next->prev_isolate = second->prev_isolate;","note":"The merge updates the successor's isolate back-pointer using the soon-to-be-freed node, creating a stale-pointer write primitive."},
  {"step":8,"file":"lib/fribidi-bidi.c","function":"merge_with_prev","line":79,"var":"second","code":"fribidi_free (second);","note":"The merged run node is freed immediately after the pointer rewiring, so any later use of that node becomes a use-after-free."},
  {"step":9,"file":"lib/fribidi-bidi.c","function":"merge_with_prev","line":73,"var":"second->next->prev_isolate","code":"second->next->prev_isolate = second->prev_isolate;","note":"This write is the memory-safety sink: the code dereferences and stores through a node whose lifetime is no longer valid under the compaction path exercised by the crafted input."}
]
p.write_text(__import__('json').dumps(trace, indent=2))
print(p)
